g.text: Follow the solid arrows for success; dashed arrows return errors to the browser.
Failure fallback: review=true; preserve clear safety escalation; expose no upstream secrets.
Human review is advisory. The app does not notify anyone, change prices or place orders.
Workspace: Overview / Evidence / JSON; copy, download, checklist; last 6 reports in tab memory.
Public barcode lookup is a separate route. Its results never enter this assessment request.
